heading: மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: The chief of great renown and his aides
Of the tiny flowers of Mullai,
With golden saddles pull the chariot
With flying speed; they gallop through
By heavy downpour; the horses seem
To cross even the wide firmament;
The long-tongued bells, adorning the chariot
At the sandy foreyard of his house,
Which is spacious; during this dusk,
Having been relieved of all her anguish,
His wife, bedecked with well-crafted jewels
Is impatient to accord him a guest’s reception
